scope: SP01.3 proposed successor semantic and signing contract derived from accepted roadmap and existing design proposal. No semantic freeze before full challenge reconciliation and consequential majority decision.
resultText:
I'll complete the missing semantic contract and decisions against the current schema and review, without re-authoring the JSON generators. First I need the assignment, binding, review, and current successor artifacts.The successor directory already has all four files; I’ll inspect their completeness against the review and binding before writing the missing contract and decisions.The existing prose is the old reviewed draft; I’ll inspect the updated schema, examples, binding, and diagnostic next so the contract can match the closed JSON.The diagnostic already names the accrual permission mismatch. I’ll inspect schema defs, examples, and the old contract with one targeted Python pass.The schema already has a full constructor set; I’ll extract the accrue permission mismatch, Core/value mapping, and hash/display rules next.Accrue fails because `allowedEffectSet` uses effect names. I’ll map those to Core ops, recompute dependent hashes, and check the invalid fixture contexts.Three state preimages still list EffectKind names. I’ll convert those to Core ops and recompute the dependent hashes.Schema and examples now agree on CoreOp permissions. I’ll write the contract, decisions, and reports against those closed definitions.The missing prose is in place. `semantic-contract.md` and `semantic-decisions.json` now match the closed JSON defs. The interrupted accrue example is corrected without widening the schema.

## Narrow correction

`ResidualCapability.allowedEffectSet` stays a `CoreOp` list. It does not accept `EffectKind` names. The accrue seed listed `Accrual` and `DueCreated` (effects of `DebtAccrue` / `DebtCreate`). Those strings are now `DebtAccrue`, `DebtCreate`, `RequestCancel` on the signed document, successor, loan state, post-state, and prepared residual.

Accrue `exactPlanDigest`: `424b671c…2402255d` → `67649e18ca59c07474cca39b43c233a91071fc29872e751ae1165c4c9314cd0f`. Dependent `stateHash`, `authorityDigest`, `acceptanceBind`, and `preparedHash` were recomputed from retained preimages.

## R1–R8

| ID | Disposition | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | Specified. 38 `CoreOp`s, closed `EffectKind`/`ExactEffect`, `StoredValue` (Bool, Quantity, Debt, Shares, records, options, collections), Position/Request/Message/EventClaim/RewardAccount, genesis/admin. | contract B, schema `$defs` |
| R2 | Specified and schema-checked. True-end `(?![\s\S])`. Widths in DomainValidation. Four claim kinds `contains` exactly once. | contract A.1/C |
| R3 | Specified. FIELD_META is schema `x-display`. Every-leaf walk, empty `[]`/`{}`, indexed entries, Price unit `base` per `quote`. | contract E |
| R4 | Specified. Closed bodies and framed DAG. Host SHA-256 recomputed. Native hash unresolved. | contract D, `preimageRegistry` |
| R5 | Specified. Principal/accrued/cap/allocation/conversion/negative rate. Price `basePerQuote`. Remainder is not an input Transfer. | contract F |
| R6 | Specified. Actor-indexed ledgers, successor binds original intent, Pinned vs AdmittedContext vs GenesisNone. Refunds do not restore gross. Fees count in net. Duties survive cancel. | contract G |
| R7 | Specified. Charge 1 per CoreOp. Recovery aliases `recoveryRemaining`. Split/join/cancel/migrate. Interleave `write_path_or_identity_or_cap_key`. Par `disjoint_keys_concat_obs`. Profile maxima 4096/16384/65536/8. | contract H |
| R8 | Specified-only. Net-after-fees includes Fee 30. Clone has two children. Cancel has a winning fill. Migrate recomputes `executionBodyHash`. No context evaluator ran. | contract I |

`SD-COMPOSITION` no longer leaves interleave conflict open. Native, proof, ACTUS day-count, cumulative MC04/MC05 tests, and majority votes stay open.

## Checks that ran

Draft 2020-12 `check_schema` plus all four positives: swap, outcome-intent, genesis, accrue. Accrue now schema-passes. Newline/CR/U+2028, cap newline, and four-copy `ContractInvariant` fail schema. `2^64` and `2^128` still schema-pass and remain domain rejects. Host framed hashes match the registry. Old `bounds.json` / `types.ts` / `codec.ts` hashes unchanged.

Contract 4129 words (limit 8000). Six owned files 481896 bytes (limit 524288).

This remains a proposal. Independent GPT-6 review, SP01.2 reconciliation, and majority freeze are still required. No runtime, native, or implementation acceptance is claimed.
